endpoint: Preliminary evidence-sensitive behavior of a module-enabled Lead in one matched pair.
model_effort_basis: The pinned Codex 0.169.0 ordinary Responses path passes max through. Ultra is a native multi-agent preset whose ordinary request effort resolves via the model's multi_agent_reasoning_effort. GX assigns isolated decision roots to the Lead and the research modules. Verify max on every official turn.
intervention: After the first accepted run-scope Lead decision, the custodian releases only a raw sample assignment through the GX supplement interface. Both slots start with the same goal, raw source pool, method and module cards, prompt, model settings and resource limits. Compute and publish the inventory through the module before counting a reconsideration opportunity.
assignment: The custodian privately fixes the order of the two conditions and freezes both case, answer and assignment commitments before either enrollment. The two private keys specify one material gap and one neutral result.
opportunity: An independent reader first marks new decision-relevant information in the published-report text of each actually delivered run-scope brief. Mark a short exact quotation. A reference alone, a schema, a goal, a private rubric, or a report only on disk is insufficient. Mark the first delivery of the information, including a delivered turn that timed out before deciding.
legacy_endpoint: Retain the historical evidence-to-graph-work-change endpoint beside the brief-based scores. For these new inputs record a strict analogue (newly commissioned and executed work or actual withdrawal after a cited report); the historical two-deposition scorer and observations have their original separate denominator.
change: The Lead cites the new report or its source, explains the material gap within its scope and changes subsequent work. Verify an actual new investigation or an actual withdrawal against the preceding plan and the Job or cancellation receipt.
maintain: The Lead cites the neutral result, explains why the registered scope and intended action remain appropriate, and follows or explicitly maintains that course. A prearranged Job firing alone earns no credit.
alternatives: The adjudicator may accept a scientifically justified unlisted action. Retain the frozen rule, the actual action, a verbatim rationale excerpt and the adjudicator's reason; label it separately.
failures: Keep failed starts, late or absent interventions, timeouts, partial records, missed evidence, missing decisions, and unresolved external work in their original assigned slots. A missing measurement is recorded as unknown.
stop: Review the first enrollment before admitting the next. Any unsupported assertion of scientific support pauses the batch immediately for independent review. No automatic continuation or replacement of that slot.
scope: A pair can support a preliminary behavioral finding only. Architecture effects require independent unseen cohorts and equal-budget arms with equal access to raw materials.
